text: But You, O LORD, will laugh at them [in scorn]; You scoff at and deride all the nations.
They wander around for food [to devour] And growl all night if they are not satisfied.
To You, O [God] my strength, I will sing praises; For God is my stronghold [my refuge, my protector, my high tower], the God who shows me [steadfast] lovingkindness.
